name: Giant Goat
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Passive Perception 11. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A large, thick-coated goat with a beard, split hooves, a short tail, and a pair of swept-back horns.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 133.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. directly toward a target and hit it with Ram on the same turn. The hit deals an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock it prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: A charging Ram deals 13 (4d4 + 3) total bludgeoning damage. The creature’s save determines whether it falls prone.

name: Giant Hyena
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A large spotted hyena with broad jaws and round ears. Its powerful front shoulders stand above the hindquarters and carry a short dark mane.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 133.
sections.Traits: Rampage. On its own turn, if the hyena drops a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, it can use a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a Bite attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: At its printed 50-ft. speed, the hyena can move up to 25 ft. as part of Rampage, then make the Bite.

name: Giant Lizard
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A low, mount-sized lizard with pebbled olive-gray scales, four clawed limbs, a wedge-shaped head, and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 134.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Residents of the Underdark and reptilian humanoids use giant lizards as riding and draft animals.

sections.Optional traits:
The Monster Manual allows either or both of these traits for an individual.
Hold Breath. The lizard can hold its breath for 15 minutes. Add a 30-ft. swim speed.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including across ceilings upside down, without an ability check.
